name: Network Topology
description: Discovers all devices in the network and draws an editable map – an editor in the style of Upload Labs: node types incl. management, controller, subnet, VM, LXC and Docker, own nodes with name/IP/OS and assigned agents, lines in four styles (Default, PCB, Web, Cable) with colours, names, end labels (port, WAN, LAN2 …) and arrows, named flows with legend (e.g. Backup, Sync, VPN), boxes around areas, snap grid, multi-select, personal backgrounds.
author: BYTERA
